theme: Last day ashore, then a week at sea.
greeting: The whole day is open before you board this evening, Dan — Dubrovnik is yours until the lines come off around 5. The catch is that everything needing dry land and a signal has to happen today, because the boat goes quiet for the week.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Cavtat transfers and early checkout
needsAttention.detail: Three things can only be arranged from shore: the Komolac→Cavtat transfer on the 19th, a bag hold at the hotel before 3 PM check-in, and the ~5:15 AM checkout on Sun the 20th for your 7:30 flight. Charter connectivity is poor to nonexistent once you sail.

needsAttention.title: Confirm boarding and the return transfer with Nautilus
needsAttention.detail: Pin down the exact meeting time and place for tonight's ~5 PM boarding, and arrange the airport transfer for disembarking Sat the 19th — far easier now than once you're underway.

needsAttention.title: Provision in Dubrovnik before boarding
needsAttention.detail: Cash (~€200), snacks, the week's alcohol, and any gluten-free non-perishables are all easier ashore than aboard. Studenac, Tommy, or Konzum downtown.

needsAttention.title: Book the St Pete landing nights and the SUV
needsAttention.detail: You land TPA on the 20th straight off a week dark at sea. The Sept 20–Oct 5 Full-Size SUV is now a firm book-it, and the Sept 20–21 St Pete gap is still open — both far easier from shore today.

flagged.title: LinkedIn alert: Sr. Government Relations Manager
flagged.detail: A new Government Relations role via Jobgether hit your alerts — worth a look when you're back ashore.

flagged.title: Chase statement ready
flagged.detail: Statement posted, $217.84 due Oct 8, auto-pay on — nothing owed before you go.

inbox.noise: Around 40 newsletters, promos, campaign asks, receipts, and Airbnb review pings — none need you.

recipe.title: Duck breasts with apples & caraway
recipe.why: An autumn dish that leans on what the season brings to the table.

acts.line: The morning is open — a good window for the Dubrovnik provisioning run before the shops fill up.
Make the calls that can't happen at sea: Cavtat transfers, the Nautilus meet point, the return airport transfer.
Lines off around 5, and a week on the water begins.
